• One Scion per army can be upgraded to a Baron for +15 points.
• Has access to weapons and gear from the Armory.
Baron: A Baron may select an additional target.

Oath of Moment: At the beginning of the first battle round, select one enemy unit. For the rest of the battle, all friendly <Feudal Levy> and <Noble> units may re-roll one Hit roll and one Wound or Armor Penetration roll per activation when attacking the selected unit.

Pilot: Each <Knight> unit selected in this AOP must be assigned one Scion/Baron from the same AOP. Each Scion/Baron may only be assigned to one <Knight> unit. An assigned Scion/Baron must start the battle embarked within its <Knight>, even though the vehicle has no Transport Capacity, and cannot disembark unless the <Knight> is destroyed. When this happens, the Scion/Baron disembarks following the normal rules for passengers in a destroyed Transport. If there is no <Knight> without an assigned <Scion> left, a Scion/Baron may start the game inside an <Armiger> instead.
